name: What are the common causes of fence instability in the Berkeley area?

mainEntity.name: What are the common causes of fence instability in the Berkeley area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Berkeley and East Bay areas, common causes of fence instability include soil erosion due to rainfall, strong winds, aging wood posts rotting at ground level, pest damage like termites, and sometimes seismic activity. Improper installation or insufficient post depth can also contribute to instability over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fence instability in Berkeley is often caused by soil erosion, strong winds, rotting wood posts, pest damage, and seismic activity.
